title: Monster Definition
description: Defines a monster card with stats, skills, and evolution data. Based on the Tower of Saviors monster system where each monster has element affinity, level-scaled stats, skill bindings, and an optional evolution path.

rarity.description: Star rarity of the monster (1 through 8).

max_level.description: Maximum level this monster can reach.

cost.description: Team cost consumed when this monster is placed on a team.

active_skill_id.description: Reference to the active skill definition, or null if the monster has no active skill.

leader_skill_id.description: Reference to the leader skill definition, or null if the monster has no leader skill.

team_skill_ids.description: List of team skill definition IDs this monster can participate in.

evolve_to.description: Monster ID of the evolution target, or null if this monster cannot evolve.

evolve_materials.description: List of monster IDs required as materials to perform evolution.

exp_curve.description: Experience curve that governs how much EXP is needed per level.
